player_prompt.intro:
I nana Countdown lamɛnɛrɛnw jɛkulu!
Kɔnɔ: Lamɛnɛrɛnw ka bɔ sɛbɛn +, -, *, / ka kɔ target. 
Kɛlɛkɛlaw sɛbɛn: [i j op] ka kɔ i,j ye lamɛnɛrɛnw ye, op ye ko operation. 
Sɛbɛn: [0 2 *] ye lamɛnɛrɛnw anw kɔ index 0 ka kɔ index 2. 
Wari bɛna fɔlɔ fɛɛrɛ ye sɛbɛn ka kɔ sɛbɛn ye.

board.progress:
{observation}
Tunbe tun bɛ se ka sɛbɛn: {progress}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛlɛ bɔnɛ bɛɛ kɔrɔ. Fa `[i j op]` kɔrɔ i,j bɛ indices ani op bɛ +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Indices non valides. U ka kan ka kɛ danfara ye ani u bɛ se ka taa 0-{max_index} ma
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Baara min tɛ bɛn (farali ni fu ye walima jatiden dafalen ma)

outcome.win: O ye laɲini kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenba de ye: {target}
outcome.no_moves: Tɛ̀ ka sɔrɔ cɛ̀nin. Kɛlɛw ka ca: {best_value} (kɛlɛw bɛ jɛ̀: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Wakati bɛ̀ɛ sɔrɔ. Kɛlɛw ka ca: {best_value} (kɛlɛw bɛ jɛ̀: {target})
